subject: Re: Dedicated capacity offer — conversion incentive & short-term burst plan
messages:
From: Joe Thompson <joe@acmecorp.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted -> Dedicated: conversion credits and bridge months

Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about moving some of our high-volume routes to Dedicated. Before we get legal involved, procurement asked for clarity on two items we need to budget: 1) conversion credits or discounts you offer when moving committed volume from Hosted to Dedicated, and 2) any short-term bridge or burst month options if we need temporary capacity while sizing the pool.

Attached is a small usage snapshot for Q1. High-level: 120M tokens/month across 4 production routes, peak 220 RPS during business hours. We're targeting an initial reserved commit for 8x A100-equivalent GPUs but open to recommendations.

Can you share a proposed structure (credits, offsets, duration) and any guarantees around throughput?

Best,
Joe
Procurement, ACME Corp

Attachment: usage_snapshot_Q1.csv (stated as attachment)
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Joe Thompson <joe@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@acmecorp.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: conversion credits and bridge months

Joe — thanks for the snapshot and the clear ask. High level proposal below; I'm attaching a formal PDF with line items.

Proposal summary (draft):
- Conversion credit: We offer a one-time credit equal to 30% of a 6-month Hosted run-rate when customers commit to a 12-month Dedicated reserved capacity. For ACME's numbers this maps to a ~3-month effective credit against Dedicated invoices.
- Commit offsets: We can tier the committed GPU pool sizing so the first 2 months are billed at 50% of committed rate (transition discount) to absorb sizing variance.
- Short-term burst/bridge months: We can provide up to 2 bridge months where ACME may burst beyond commit at a reduced premium (1.25x vs standard 1.5x) while we finalize autoscaling policies.
- Throughput guarantees: We guarantee 95th percentile per-request latency SLA at targeted throughput for the committed GPU class (A100-equivalent) and minimum sustained RPS per GPU. If we miss targets, we provide service credits (0.5% invoice credit per missed month, capped at 5%).

Next steps: If that aligns, I'll loop in finance (Laura) for final discount approval and we can produce a clean committed quote and contract terms. Also looping Rishi on SLA details and tech sizing.

Attached: ACME_Redwood_Dedicated_Proposal_v2.pdf

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated: conversion credits and bridge months

Camila — quick notes from infra side on throughput guarantees:
- For an 8-GPU A100-equivalent pool, we should dimension for sustained 200 RPS across the pool with KV cache and batching optimizations; bursts to 320 RPS are possible for short windows if prefix caching hits >60%.
- The SLA language needs to be explicit about sequence lengths (we recommend basing guarantees on 2k token windows; longer windows will require additional margin).
- For the transition discount (first 2 months at 50%), we should add a clause that if usage exceeds 2.5x the committed baseline, the excess is billed at standard burst pricing to avoid abuse.

I can draft the technical appendix for the proposal if you want.

—Rishi
Senior Infra PM, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Camila — get me the updated numbers (P&L impact) and I'll sign off immediately.
